text:
riley_people_ops: Heads-up — new pilot next month at SF: Mezzanine Focus Week (Mon 2026-07-06 through Fri 2026-07-10). Purpose: experiment with a dedicated low-interruption wing for heads-down work and streamline visitor intake with a kiosk+escort flow. Short summary first, details below.

riley_people_ops: Summary: mezzanine (2nd floor) designated Focus Wing 9:30am-3:30pm, reduced background music, two dedicated focus rooms (single-occupancy), guest kiosk at lobby + mandatory escort for visitors, same-day flex passes limited to 8/day per team, evening communal dinner Tues @6:30 (RSVP), and a weekend facility deep-clean Sat 2026-07-11. No office closure. :calendar: :busts_in_silhouette: :plate_with_cutlery:

kai_facilities: Note — we9ll be installing two pop-up focus booths Mon night. Freight access available Mon 18:00-19:30. If you need gear moved DM me.

nina_engineering: Quick Q: are meetings allowed on the Focus Wing? We often run pairing sessions.

riley_people_ops: Good q. Short answer: small pairing allowed but please use the focus rooms for solo heads-down work. For scheduled meetings, use bookable conference rooms on floors 1 or 3. We9ll mark space types in the booking app.

omar_product: How do teams get same-day flex passes? Last pilot had folks confused.

riley_people_ops: Same-day flex passes will be requested via the intranet banner (intra.redwood.company/focus-week). Rules: teams can request up to 8 same-day passes total, per day; passes are first-come-first-served; pass holders must check in at the kiosk. For recurring needs, apply via people-ops and we9ll allocate a small recurring pool.

cass_hybrid: Will commuter shuttles change schedule during Focus Week? I rely on the 8:10 AM shuttle.

kai_facilities: Shuttle schedule stays the same. We9ll add one extra AM run Wed only for anticipated demand. Exact schedule posted on the shuttle board and Slack channel.

ops-bot: SECURITY KIOSK: New visitor kiosk deployed Wed 2026-07-01 — visitors without pre-registration will be asked to wait for an escort.

nina_engineering: If I9m on-call and need a quiet desk, can I book a focus room the day-of?

riley_people_ops: Yes, on-call exceptions are allowed. Use the booking app and tag the reservation as "on-call". If you need a guaranteed recurring slot, DM me.

omar_product: RSVP for Tues dinner? Link?

riley_people_ops: RSVP here: https://intra.redwood.company/events/focus-week-dinner. Will be vegetarian-friendly + gluten-free options. We9ll limit to 60 people.

cass_hybrid: Any vendor/contractor changes? We often have design contractors dropping by.

kai_facilities: Contractors must pre-register for Focus Week. Day-of contractor visits will require an escort and a time window. We9ll also issue temporary badges valid only for the mezzanine during pilot hours.

nina_engineering: Maintenance alerts? Last pop-up event blocked a conference room.

kai_facilities: Minor AC tune-up Tue 2026-07-07 17:00-18:30 affecting mezzanine HVAC only. We9ll post signs; no noisy work during 9:30-15:30 focus hours.

ops-bot: DEEP CLEAN: Saturday 2026-07-11 scheduled for mezzanine; please clear shared desks by Friday 18:00.

omar_product: Will we collect feedback during the pilot?

riley_people_ops: Yes 9two quick surveys: after day 2 and at the end of week. We'll publish anonymized utilization stats and a short write-up.

cass_hybrid: Accessibility accommodations? My teammate uses a standing desk and needs a power outlet near the desk.

riley_people_ops: Please reply here or email people-ops@redwood.ai with accommodation requests; facilities will ensure accessible spots and power.

nina_engineering: Thanks, sounds promising.

riley_people_ops: Thanks everyone. If you9d like to be a floor host during the pilot (help with gentle reminders and seat guidance) sign up here: https://intra.redwood.company/ops/floor-hosts. We9re aiming for 4 hosts/day. :raised_hands:
